comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: Again I am humbled. I too had the picture of mountains and base camps and that's it. Buddha, Sita, source of the tiered pagoda, the history of Nepal (3 rival cities in a bowl) and all the others, the layered climatic zones, the palace coup and abolition of the monarchy, the Maoists and the export of young men's labour - all new to me. Thank you for this thoroughly researched and presented jewel.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Glad the full picture came through - Nepal so often gets reduced to "mountains and base camps" in people's minds, when there's this whole layered history underneath: three rival cities in one valley, a monarchy that ended within living memory, and the ongoing story of labor migration shaping the country today. Thank you for such a generous read of it.
